unreleasedSourceNotes: 0.6.59 is a source-only passive-updater render correction over the accepted rustls security patch. A closed updater check now patches the transport status instead of rebuilding the whole studio at both begin/completion; explicit checks and visible/available updater panels retain their existing rendering. New production-browser controls preserve studio DOM for closed checks and retain available-update visibility. Native audio/capture, project schema, dependencies, TLS trust and updater policy are unchanged. No 0.6.59 installer or installed acceptance exists. Explicit UI Stop now refreshes cancelled audition controls immediately; previously an incidental startup redraw masked a disabled Hear button after Stop. The menu control now proves the startup callback ran while requiring no studio redraw, retaining focus checks; the pending-start control additionally requires Hear to re-enable before the stale completion is released.

The accepted dependency-only 0.6.58 source at 1eecf8c8212171f240a078f7b977fc3a390c80c2 passed terminal CI and CodeQL, but preparation stopped before any native release build/package/receipt: 76/77 production browser cases passed and long-song worker UI responsiveness measured 184.9 ms against the unchanged 150 ms limit. One profiled diagnostic reproduced 179.1 ms and attributed consecutive full renders to checkForUpdates at startup. Both new closed-updater controls failed against the unchanged 0.6.58 production bundle before this fix. All failed logs, traces and profiler evidence remain retained; no installer or microphone action occurred.

0.6.58 is a source-only security replacement candidate: rustls 0.23.40 to 0.23.46 and its required rustls-webpki 0.103.13 to 0.103.14 patch. No app, updater-plugin, reqwest, capture, DSP, project-schema or signing-policy behavior is changed. No 0.6.58 installer, receipt, installed acceptance or publication exists. Review the exact source and locked Windows tests before preparing a replacement installer.

The frozen 0.6.57 candidate at fc619a1dfaacf8c07b86147b5dcbf39058e56032 passed exact-installed candidate verification and independent acceptance. Its artifacts and private evidence remain immutable; publication was paused for the Windows rustls advisory. Earlier source-only status notes below are historical checkpoints, not the final 0.6.57 acceptance. That acceptance does not transfer to 0.6.58. Latest public release remains 0.6.50; historical published smoke fields remain unchanged.

0.6.56 is a separate source-only correction to the main-based integration. Ordinary Play and Restart share preparation/request and engine-generation ownership so Stop, Pause, Seek or a newer start cannot be undone by a delayed completion. Existing MIDI/Finish ownership is composed, not replaced. Residency hints retain only the latest revision per asset, with at most256 entries and512 characters per key; forgotten hints preserve full-byte fallback. No0.6.56 installer or installed acceptance exists.

notes: 0.6.50 was published from exact tested commit ec3f783b24abdd85d46229c2893ea953e96248cd using one prepare pass, fresh-audible installed evidence, evidence-only candidate verification, and exact publication without rebuilding or restaging.

Fixes whole-row melody instrument changes, blocking native stem renders, and playback recovery after decoded cache eviction. Installed Melody 3 changes persisted in all A-H source arrays, and native Play passed on the original and reopened test song.
The combined installed smoke retained 10.049977 seconds of 48 kHz mono microphone PCM (peak 0.4734497, RMS 0.0545173), 19 live loopMIDI notes, punched take lanes, and verified WAV/MIDI exports.

Installed media portability, deterministic VST3 instrument/effect hosting, and owned MIDI conversion passed. Godot 4.6.3 and Chromium 149 decoded all six final pack WAVs with nonzero PCM and exact section-loop durations.

CI including Windows native, and both CodeQL languages passed on the release commit. All 11 public receipt-bound assets were downloaded and hash-verified; both latest manifests report 0.6.50 and the setup URL returns HTTP 200. The unchanged itch bootstrapper was not repushed.

Exact installer and full direct fresh-audible evidence are retained under ignored local-artifacts/archive/packages/pocket-daw/0.6.50-ec3f783b and local-artifacts/release-evidence/pocket-daw/0.6.50-sound-fixes for future fingerprint-compatible baseline reuse.
